name: DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontC_le
typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat),
  DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.Ok N →
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      (∀ (x : ν), Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) x → LE.le.{0} (c x) L) →
        ∀ (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
          (∀ (a : Prod.{0, 0} ν ν),
              Membership.mem.{0, 0} U a → Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N) a) →
            LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} U) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) →
              ∀ (seen front : List.{0} ν),
                (∀ (y : ν),
                    Membership.mem.{0, 0} seen y →
                      Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) y) →
                  (∀ (y : ν),
                      Membership.mem.{0, 0} front y →
                        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N) y) →
                    LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} seen) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N)) →
                      LE.le.{0} (List.length.{0} front) (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N)) →
                        LE.le.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.newFrontC N c U seen front)
                          (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.frontB
                            (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.nodes N))
                            (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.arcs N)) L)

source.code:
theorem newFrontC_le (hN : N.Ok) (L : ℕ) (hL : ∀ x ∈ N.nodes, c x ≤ L) (U : List (ν × ν))
    (hU : ∀ a ∈ U, a ∈ N.arcs) (hm : U.length ≤ N.arcs.length) (seen front : List ν)
    (hs : ∀ y ∈ seen, y ∈ N.nodes) (hf : ∀ y ∈ front, y ∈ N.nodes)
    (hsl : seen.length ≤ N.nodes.length) (hfl : front.length ≤ N.nodes.length) :
    N.newFrontC c U seen front ≤ frontB N.nodes.length N.arcs.length L := by
  unfold newFrontC frontB
  apply sum_map_le_of_le
  intro y hy
  have h1 := N.memNC_le c L hL seen y hs hy
  have h2 := N.memNC_le c L hL front y hf hy
  have h3 : (front.map (fun x => 1 + N.resC c U x y)).sum ≤
      front.length * (1 + resB N.arcs.length L) := by
    apply sum_map_le_of_le
    intro x hx
    have := N.resC_le c hN L hL U hU hm x y (hf x hx) hy
    omega
  have e1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (1 + 2 * L) hsl
  have e2 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (1 + 2 * L) hfl
  have e3 := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (1 + resB N.arcs.length L) hfl
  nlinarith
